ev.q: Sheltered is a post-apocalyptic survival game
to survive various threats, such as starvation, radiation poisoning, and dehydration
Players will need to extend the shelter, build toilets and showers for hygiene
Players control a family that survives a nuclear war
choosing a positive one when creating the characters
the family will need to go on expeditions, the map is randomly generated
different locations contain different loot unique to them
A family survives a nuclear war by taking refuge in an underground shelter
